title: Spann v. Oak Mountain Presbyterian Church
disposition_detail: Appeal dismissed as premature: no record of a judicial decision by Oak Mountain Presbyterian Church or of an appeal to Evangel Presbytery. Dismissal was conditioned on Appellant providing evidence of such a lower decision and appeal. The SJC requested that Evangel Presbytery obtain a written response from the OMPC Session. No merits reached. Adopted as amended; 18 concurring, 1 dissenting, 1 not qualified, 1 recused, 3 absent.
first_summary: An individual appealed to the SJC after her church allegedly excommunicated her without process and violated Matthew 18. The SJC dismissed the appeal as premature because there was no record of a judicial decision by the church or of an appeal to Evangel Presbytery. It noted excommunication's severity and asked Evangel Presbytery to obtain a written response from the session.
summary: An individual appealed directly to the SJC, alleging her church effectively excommunicated her without process, failed the Matthew 18 process, and spiritually abused her by social isolation. The SJC dismissed as premature, without reaching the merits, because there was no record of a judicial decision by the church or of an appeal to Evangel Presbytery, the next higher court; it stated she could proceed only by providing such evidence. The severity of excommunication did not excuse that prerequisite. The SJC asked Presbytery to obtain the session's written response to her letter.

evidence_notes.dispute: Lines 13, 17-21: Spann alleged OMPC effectively excommunicated her without process, failed Matthew 18, and spiritually abused her by socially isolating her. The SJC found no record of a judicial decision by OMPC or of an appeal to Evangel Presbytery.
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: Lines 23-27: Excommunication is a severe censure under BCO 30-4 and should follow BCO 36-6, but the SJC held the appeal premature under BCO 42-2 and dismissed it unless Appellant provides evidence of the lower judicial decision and Presbytery appeal. It requested Evangel Presbytery to seek a written response from OMPC's Session. Line 27 states the appeal is dismissed.
